## What this changes

<!-- One change per pull request. What does it do, and why? -->

## Type

- [ ] New real-bug case (`cases/real/...`)
- [ ] Reviewer adapter (`reviewreplay/subjects/...`)
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature or grading change
- [ ] Docs or website

## Checklist

- [ ] It does one thing, and the title says what (for example "cases: add real-013 from rich")
- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes locally
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, private code or personal paths in the diff
- [ ] A new case credits its source and licence in `NOTES.md`, and its answer key was checked against the upstream fix
- [ ] Any number in docs or the website traces to a file under `results/`
- [ ] Linked issue, if there is one: #
